canonical_name: Freeport AI Energy Campus, West Calder (West Lothian)

aliases.alias: Land At Former Freeport Shopping & Leisure Village, Westwood, West Calder

summary: Proposed 250 MW 'AI Energy Campus' by Apatura on the former Freeport shopping and leisure village site at Westwood, north-west of West Calder, West Lothian, paired with a 250 MW battery energy storage system to be consented separately via a Section 36 application to Scottish Ministers. Despite the site name, this is the former Freeport outlet village, not a UK 'Green Freeport' tax zone. An EIA screening request (0346/EIA/25) was determined 'Environmental Assessment Not Required' on 4 June 2025 and a Proposal of Application Notice (0625/PAC/25) received a PAC response on 14 August 2025. The developer targeted a planning application in Q1/Q2 2026, but no validated application had been located as of 30 July 2026. Apatura claims a NESO grid connection offer at Harburn substation accepted in Q2 2025 and £1.7bn investment; job numbers are not quantified.
maturity_explanation: Early development, verified: EIA screening 0346/EIA/25 determined 'Environmental Assessment Not Required' (4 June 2025) and PAN 0625/PAC/25 processed with PAC response issued 14 August 2025 on the West Lothian Council portal. No validated planning application for the data centre, and no Section 36 application for the BESS, located as of 30 July 2026, although the developer's published timeline targeted submission in Q1/Q2 2026. Not M2 until an application is verified as validated.

latest_development.headline: West Lothian Council issues pre-application consultation response to PAN 0625/PAC/25; developer consultation ran Q3 2025 with application targeted for Q1/Q2 2026 (not yet located)
